summary: Risk-off into November: Nasdaq -2.8% Friday on AI-spending fears after Amazon and Intel guidance, while Hormuz tanker attacks keep Brent near $117. Busy week: Apple tonight, US midterms Tuesday, RBA Tuesday, BoE Thursday, US jobs Friday.
events_next_24h: Tue 08:00 USD Apple earnings (after US close)
Tue all day USD US midterm elections; Japan market holiday (Culture Day)
Tue 14:30 AUD RBA rate decision (just outside 24h)
tier1_next_14d: US Non-Farm Payrolls (Oct) · Sat, 7 Nov, 00:30 (expected date)

ES.why: S&P fell 1.83% Friday with ~70% of stocks down as AI-spending fears and a likely December Fed hike weigh. Funds positioning neutral (35th pct).
ES.risk: Apple beat tonight or a calm midterm result sparks a relief rally.

NQ.why: Nasdaq -2.84% Friday, worst month in over a year, as Amazon and Intel guidance hit AI names. Funds still crowded long (94th pct) adds downside fuel.
NQ.risk: Strong Apple results after tonight's close or a sharp fall in yields.

YM.why: Dow fell a milder 1.06% and is less exposed to the AI selloff; energy majors beat, but a hawkish Fed and $104 oil weigh.
YM.risk: A broad risk-off leg on election or Iran news drags the Dow lower.

RTY.why: Small caps fell 2% Friday after rallying Thursday on softer PCE; December hike odds near 75% hurt them, rotation out of tech helps.
RTY.risk: A dovish surprise in data lifts small caps; more hike talk sinks them.

NKD.why: Nikkei fell 2.1% Friday and 5.2% in October, seen opening ~1.5% lower after US tech losses and a China PMI back in contraction. Funds lean short (22nd pct), not crowded.
NKD.risk: A strong Apple print and US tech rebound, or a sharply weaker yen.

6J.why: Yen gained three sessions on haven demand and BOJ said hikes remain possible (Dec hike ~80% priced); US-Japan rate gap still caps it. Funds neutral (74th pct).
6J.risk: Risk-on rebound or hawkish Fed talk pushes USD/JPY back up.

6E.why: ECB paused at 2.5% while French 10y yields hover near 5% and Lagarde announced an early exit; Fed hike odds favour the dollar.
6E.risk: Hawkish ECB speakers or softer US data lift the euro.

6B.why: BoE expected to hike to 4.00% on Thursday, which supports sterling, but global risk-off and high oil weigh; no clear edge before the decision.
6B.risk: A firm BoE hike signal Thursday or a deeper risk-off move.

6A.why: China's official factory PMI slipped to 49.3 and risk is off, but the RBA is ~90% priced to hike to 4.85% Tuesday 2:30pm; wait for both.
6A.risk: A hawkish RBA hike lifts AUD; a dovish hold or weak China data sinks it.

ZN.why: 10y yield fell 7bp to ~4.92% Friday on haven buying, but the Fed is in a hiking cycle and $104 oil feeds inflation; jobs data Friday.
ZN.risk: Hot ISM prices or hawkish Fed talk pushes yields up; deeper selloff pulls them down.

GC.why: Gold fell 3.7% Friday to ~$3,875 and ~7% in October despite falling yields, as Fed hike pricing lifts the dollar. Funds lean short (24th pct), limiting fuel.
GC.risk: Escalation with Iran or a sharp dollar drop revives haven buying.

CL.why: Brent ~$117 and WTI ~$104 after more Hormuz tanker attacks; Trump says no hurry on an Iran deal. Funds lean short (13th pct), so short-covering adds fuel.
CL.risk: A US-Iran deal or Iran's two-day Hormuz reopening offer being accepted.
